Barrett Asset Management Has Boosted Eog Res Com (EOG) Holding by $2.20 Million; As Facebook (FB) Valuation Declined, Shareholder Foxhaven Asset Management LP Cut Holding by $26.61 Million

Barrett Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Eog Res Inc Com (EOG) by 28.29% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Barrett Asset Management Llc bought 20,570 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.73% with the market. The institutional investor held 93,286 shares of the energy company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.07M, up from 72,716 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Barrett Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Eog Res Inc Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $68.17 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.85% or $2.22 during the last trading session, reaching $117.76. About 3.94M shares traded. EOG Resources, Inc. (NYSE:EOG) has risen 13.87% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 2.32% the S&P500.
